title: ADXL345 DEVID reads 0x00 over SPI
serial_logs:
I (402) adxl: DEVID = 0x00 (expected 0xE5)
E (403) adxl: sensor not found

reference_context.title: ADXL345 Datasheet (Analog Devices)
reference_context.snippet: For SPI, either 3- or 4-wire configuration is possible. The maximum SPI clock speed is 5 MHz. The timing scheme follows clock polarity (CPOL) = 1 and clock phase (CPHA) = 1.

reference_context.title: ADXL345 Datasheet (Analog Devices)
reference_context.snippet: The DEVID register holds a fixed device ID code of 0xE5.

expected.root_cause: The ADXL345 uses SPI mode 3 (CPOL=1, CPHA=1) but the device is configured for mode 0, so data is sampled on the wrong edge.
